## Repose 1.0.0

- Pause a selected work profile and fully reboot into Before First Unlock (BFU).
- Configurable time since the last unlock, always on or scheduled, with snooze/skip.
- Independent 24/7 failed-unlock thresholds and optional SystemUI panic PIN/password.
- SMS/HTTPS commands with selectable passphrase and signed one-use authentication.
- Native settings and credential-redacted diagnostic export.

Requires Android 13+, ARM64 and Magisk or KernelSU. Install the APK and module ZIP
from this release together. Vector/LSPosed is needed for hook-based features.
A full reboot clears temporary root; enforcement resumes when root and the module
service are restored. All rules start disabled.

The APK uses the permanent release key. SHA-256 checksums accompany both files.

readme:
# Repose

Pause a selected work profile and fully reboot an Android phone into **Before
First Unlock (BFU)**. Root enforcement runs independently of the settings app.

- Configurable time since the last unlock: always on, scheduled, or both.
- Independent, 24/7 failed-unlock threshold.
- Optional lock-screen panic PIN/password through Vector/LSPosed.
- SMS and HTTPS commands: plain passphrase, signed one-use commands, or both.
- Native Material settings, authenticated notification/Quick Settings controls,
  and credential-redacted diagnostic export.

## Install

Requires Android 13+, ARM64, Magisk or KernelSU, and a device screen lock.
Download **Repose.apk** and **Repose-module.zip** from the same
[release](https://github.com/doccstat/repose/releases/latest), install both, then
open Repose and select **Start root engine**. Choose the monitored user and optional
work profile under **Device and work profile**, then open a timer or security rule.
All triggers start disabled; **Save changes** applies your choices.

For credential-failure monitoring, activate the app's device-admin receiver. It
requests only `watch-login`, not device-owner access or data-wipe permission.
For another user's failures, install and activate the matching APK in that user.
For authenticated-only unlock timing, biometric failures or a panic credential,
enable Repose's **System UI** scope in Vector/LSPosed and restart the framework.
The app reports whether the required hook contracts are available.

A full reboot clears temporary root. Enforcement becomes available again when
root and the module service are restored. A framework-only soft restart is **not
BFU** and is not a reboot action in Repose.

## Rules and controls

**Any unlock** includes trusted-device unlocks. Credential/biometric-only options
require the hook plus an actual lock-screen dismissal. Screen wakes and storage
unlock restoration never restart a timer. A fresh installation has no timestamp
until it observes a qualifying unlock; framework/module restarts preserve the timer.

Each timer has an explicit duration and “wait until locked” option. Scheduled
windows use time pickers, selectable weekdays and a searchable time-zone list
with a device-zone option. Overnight windows belong to their start day; equal start/end
means 24 hours. Android/Java zone rules resolve DST gaps forward and overlaps to
the earlier offset.

**Snooze** affects both timers. **Skip** affects only the current or next scheduled
window. Failed-unlock and panic triggers bypass both. Profile-pause failure can
abort the flow or continue to reboot, as selected. A failed/incomplete action is
latched until acknowledged; acknowledgment can immediately rearm an overdue timer.

Panic credentials must differ from the real credential and fit the lock-screen
input form: at least four PIN digits or printable-ASCII password characters.
Passphrases received remotely support Unicode. Input is never trimmed, renamed
or normalized. Blank credential fields preserve the saved value; **Remove saved
credential** explicitly removes it on Save after disabling its dependent modes.
Edits stay in the screen until saved; Back offers to discard them. Rotation keeps
an open draft. If Android closes the app, re-enter unsaved credentials or explicitly
choose **Keep saved credentials**.

Enable SMS permission only when using SMS commands. The app does not become the
default SMS app or delete received messages. A plain passphrase can be replayed by
anyone who obtains it; signed commands have persistent one-use protection.
See [remote commands](docs/remote.md) for the sender and LastSignal inbox adapter.

## Diagnostics and builds

Use **Export diagnostics** in the toolbar menu or **Status and permissions**.
The status page also shows hook capabilities and notification access; SMS and
credential-monitoring access are requested beside their rules.
Reports include version, platform,
configuration, hook capabilities, errors and operation results; credentials,
command bodies, device identifiers and inbox URLs are excluded. Export is local
and never uploaded automatically. Root startup failures are also recorded in
`/data/adb/repose/startup.log`.

[Build and test](docs/build.md) · [Language support](docs/i18n.md)
readmeZh:
# 休息

暂停选定的工作配置文件并将 Android 手机完全重新启动至 **之前
首次解锁 (BFU)**。 Root 强制执行独立于设置应用程序运行。

- 自上次解锁以来的可配置时间：始终开启、预定或两者兼而有之。
- 独立、24/7 失败解锁阈值。
- 通过 Vector/LSPosed 可选的锁屏紧急 PIN/密码。
- SMS 和 HTTPS 命令：纯密码、签名的一次性命令或两者兼而有之。
- 原生材质设置、经过身份验证的通知/快速设置控件、
  和凭证编辑的诊断导出。

## 安装

需要 Android 13+、ARM64、Magisk 或 KernelSU，以及设备屏幕锁定。
从同一目录下载 **Repose.apk** 和 **Repose-module.zip**
[release](https://github.com/doccstat/repose/releases/latest)，安装两者，然后
打开 Repose 并选择 **启动根引擎**。选择受监控的用户和可选
**设备和工作配置文件**下的工作配置文件，然后打开计时器或安全规则。
所有触发器开始禁用； **保存更改**应用您的选择。

对于凭据失败监控，请激活应用程序的设备管理接收器。它
仅请求“观看登录”，而不请求设备所有者访问或数据擦除权限。
对于其他用户的失败，请在该用户中安装并激活匹配的 APK。
对于仅经过身份验证的解锁计时、生物识别失败或恐慌凭证，
在 Vector/LSPosed 中启用 Repose 的 **系统 UI** 范围并重新启动框架。
该应用程序报告所需的挂钩合同是否可用。

完全重新启动会清除临时根。当以下情况时，可以再次执行：
root 和模块服务已恢复。仅框架软重启是**不行的
BFU** 并且不是 Repose 中的重新启动操作。

## 规则和控制

**任何解锁**包括受信任设备解锁。仅凭证/生物识别选项
需要挂钩加上实际的锁屏关闭。屏幕唤醒和存储
解锁恢复永远不会重新启动计时器。全新安装没有时间戳
直到观察到合格的解锁；框架/模块重新启动保留计时器。

每个计时器都有明确的持续时间和“等待锁定”选项。预定
Windows 使用时间选择器、可选择的工作日和可搜索的时区列表
带有设备区域选项。隔夜窗口属于他们的开始日；相同的开始/结束
意思是24小时。 Android/Java 区域规则解决了 DST 向前间隔和重叠的问题
较早的偏移量。

**贪睡**会影响两个计时器。 **跳过**仅影响当前或下一个计划的
窗口。解锁失败和恐慌触发器都会绕过这两者。配置文件暂停失败可以
根据选择中止流程或继续重新启动。失败/不完整的操作是
锁定直至确认；确认可以立即重新设置逾期定时器。

恐慌凭证必须与真实凭证不同并且适合锁屏
输入形式：至少四个 PIN 数字或可打印的 ASCII 密码字符。
远程接收的密码短语支持 Unicode。输入永远不会被修剪、重命名
或归一化。空白凭证字段保留保存的值； **删除已保存的
禁用其依赖模式后，credential** 在“保存”时显式删除它。
编辑内容将保留在屏幕中直至保存； Back 提议丢弃它们。旋转保持
一份公开草案。如果 Android 关闭应用程序，请重新输入未保存的凭据或明确
选择**保留保存的凭据**。

仅在使用短信命令时启用短信权限。该应用程序不会成为
默认短信应用程序或删除收到的消息。简单的密码可以通过以下方式重放
任何获得它的人；签名命令具有持久的一次性保护。
有关发送方和 LastSignal 收件箱适配器，请参阅[远程命令](docs/remote.md)。

## 诊断和构建

使用工具栏菜单中的 **导出诊断** 或 **状态和权限**。
状态页面还显示挂钩功能和通知访问；短信和
除了其规则之外，还要求进行凭证监控访问。
报告包括版本、平台、
配置、钩子能力、错误和操作结果；凭证ls，
命令正文、设备标识符和收件箱 URL 被排除在外。导出是本地的
并且从未自动上传。 root启动失败也记录在
`/data/adb/repose/startup.log`。

[构建和测试](docs/build.md) · [语言支持](docs/i18n.md)
